# Hakone GT (`hakone_gt`) — spec sheet

## Design note

A heavy, stable highway missile. Off boost below 3000 rpm it feels ordinary; past 4000 the second turbo arrives and it pulls hard to the limiter in every gear. Big brakes and a long, calm wheelbase make it the escape car of choice on open roads, less so in tight downtown blocks.

## How this car breaks

90s HSS unibody, stiff and heavy: it shrugs off light hits but the long front overhang puts the intercooler and twin radiators in the firing line. Glass hatch is large and shatters early. Cabin holds up to its era's standards; the real cost is parts — everything on it is expensive.

## Sources (type)

- manufacturer spec-class data for 90s 3.0 TT FR GTs (export trim)
- owner dyno averages for sequential-turbo 3.0 I6s on stock boost
- engineering tables (tire radius, ride frequency, opposed-piston caliper hydraulics)

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

| Axis | Box (kg·m²) | k | `inertia_kgm2` |
|---|---|---|---|
| roll | 664 | 0.80 | 530 |
| pitch | 2981 | 0.88 | 2620 |
| yaw | 3204 | 0.90 | 2880 |

## Aerodynamics

Frontal area A = 0.84·W·H = 1.94 m²; Cd = 0.31 → **CdA = 0.601 m²**. Lift Cl·A front/rear = +0.04 / +0.03 m² (class-typical; positive = lift). No add-on aero (`aero_downforce_coeffs` = 0, mods add it).

## Engine

3.0 L DOHC I6, sequential twin turbo, intercooled. Export-spec power class for 90s 3.0 TT straight-sixes (~80 kW/L); the second-turbo handover near 4000 rpm shows as the torque peak.

| rpm | N·m | kW |
|---|---|---|
| 1000 | 230 | 24.1 |
| 1500 | 280 | 44.0 |
| 2000 | 320 | 67.0 |
| 2500 | 355 | 92.9 |
| 3000 | 390 | 122.5 |
| 3500 | 420 | 153.9 |
| 4000 | 435 | 182.2 |
| 4500 | 432 | 203.6 |
| 5000 | 425 | 222.5 |
| 5500 | 412 | 237.3 |
| 6000 | 385 | 241.9 |
| 6500 | 345 | 234.8 |
| 7000 | 300 | 219.9 |

Peak **242 kW @ 6000 rpm**, **435 N·m @ 4000 rpm**. Idle 750 / redline 6800 / limiter 7000 rpm. Rotating inertia 0.18 kg·m² (class: 0.10 small four … 0.30 big-block). Engine braking 11% of peak torque = 48 N·m. Power-to-weight 149 kW/t.

## Drivetrain

6-speed manual, clutch-type rear LSD. Layout **RWD**; front diff: open; rear diff: clutch LSD, preload 80 N·m, power ramp 0.40, coast ramp 0.25. Clutch capacity 1.40 × peak torque = 610 N·m. Shift time 0.25 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 3.83 | 11.99 | 66 |
| 2 | 2.36 | 7.39 | 107 |
| 3 | 1.69 | 5.29 | 149 |
| 4 | 1.31 | 4.10 | 193 |
| 5 | 1.00 | 3.13 | 253 |
| 6 | 0.79 | 2.47 | 320 |

Final drive 3.13, reverse 3.28. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.308 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.30 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 407 kg | 1.80 Hz | 52000 N/m | 2760 N·s/m | 4140 N·s/m | 0.14 m |
| Rear | 356 kg | 1.90 Hz | 50700 N/m | 2550 N·s/m | 3820 N·s/m | 0.15 m |

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 2.2°/g with 62% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.361 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 149958 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 60084 F / 59363 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **14200 F / 0 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 2.2°/g, front share 61%. Bump stops 170000 N/m.

Alignment: camber -0.8° F / -1.3° R, toe +0.00° F / +0.15° R (+ = in), caster 6.5°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 323 mm disc, pistons per side 40 mm + 40 mm → A = 25.1 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 136 mm, pad μ = 0.42: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.42·100 bar·25.1 cm²·0.137 m = **2882 N·m**
- Rear: 324 mm disc, pistons per side 36 mm + 36 mm → A = 20.4 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 137 mm, pad μ = 0.4: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.4·100 bar·20.4 cm²·0.137 m = **2231 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 1767 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.63×), rear needs 712 N·m/wheel (capacity 3.13×). `bias_front` = f + 0.9·h/L = 0.69 (ideal distribution at 0.9 g, clamped 0.55-0.78). Handbrake 1780 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 15.5:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 11.0 m → outer-front path radius 5.38 m, rear-axle-centre radius 3.98 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.570 rad (32.6°)** (outer 28.3°, inner 38.4° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.55). Rack speed 1.4 rad/s.

## Damage lattice (`data/lattices/hakone_gt.json`)

120 nodes, 704 beams, 3 detachables, 21 component mounts.

- Generated with `gen-box-lattice --id hakone_gt --width 1.81 --length 4.515 --height 1.275 --wheelbase 2.55 --mass 357.5 --clearance 0.13` (22% of vehicle mass).
- Shaped top layer to the `coupe` profile (hood/deck/bumper tops dropped to beltline, greenhouse narrowed to 86% width).
- Beams: pillars + roof rails → hss 3.0e-04 m² (34 beams).
- Beams: cabin cell → hss 3.5e-04 m² (88 beams).
- Beams: sills → hss 4.0e-04 m² (6 beams).
- Beams: crumple (outer) rail segments → hss 3.0e-04 m² (36 beams).
- Beams: inner rail segments / firewall → hss 4.0e-04 m² (36 beams).
- Beams: hood → aluminum 1.5e-4 m² (16 beams).
- Beams: outer panels → mild_steel 1.5e-04 m² (284 beams).
- Components: radiator at row 8 ahead of the engine (fails first), longitudinal engine at row 7, gearbox in the tunnel, prop shaft to the rear axle, fuel tank ahead of the rear axle.
- Detachables: FrontBumper 3000 N·s / 6 kg, RearBumper 3000 N·s / 6 kg, Hood 3500 N·s / 9 kg.
- Node mass: engine-mount nodes ×2.5, renormalised to 358 kg total.
